The '''Firewasp''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Adno]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A variation on the standard type of speeder bike produced by Adno at the time, the A-R6 was primarily [[Color/Legends|dark]] gray with dark red markings.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Adno Firewasp was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Reputation reward for [[Binary Star Realty]], and also as part of the Galactic Ace's Starfighter Pack.
